question: Should Signal officially use channel-level `apiMode` as an account default, retain container mode as operator-managed configuration, and expose cancellation as a permanent shared plugin setup result?
rationale: These choices define durable config, upgrade, and plugin SDK behavior; tests can prove implementation consistency but cannot authorize the permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve the combined contract
options.body: Accept the plugin-owned wizard, account-level routing, operator-managed container support, and shared cancellation result after final upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow the shared API
options.body: Keep the Signal wizard but replace the new generic cancellation result with an existing narrower setup outcome before merge.

options.title: Split account routing
options.body: Land the setup wizard separately and defer per-account `apiMode` until its compatibility semantics receive independent approval.

recommendation.title: Approve the combined contract
recommendation.body: Accept the plugin-owned wizard, account-level routing, operator-managed container support, and shared cancellation result after final upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the active repository member carrying the Signal setup design and its review-driven revisions.
